name: Floorplan
hook: Interactive codebase map + health checker for Claude Code and Codex: draws plain-English maps of parts, files, and cross-repo connections, then flags exposed keys, open DB tables, and unverified webhooks. Surged 2,000+ stars since Oct 27 and is still on the weekly trending list—one of the fastest-climbing plugins in the ecosystem.
install: claude plugin marketplace add haydenschmitty/floorplan && claude plugin install floorplan@floorplan

name: Hallmark (Anti-AI-Slop Design Skill)
hook: Hassan El Mghari (Nutlope) and Together AI built this design skill to fight cookie-cutter AI-generated UIs: 20 hand-curated visual themes and 65 pre-ship quality gates applied every time you generate UI with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. Crossed 46,000 GitHub stars and landed back on the weekly trending list this week.

name: Claude for Manufacturing (Anthropic)
hook: Announced Nov 12, Anthropic's new industry-vertical Cowork plugin ships 17 workflow skills for manufacturing teams (quoting/RFQ, NCRs, production reporting, maintenance diagnosis) with four first-party connectors: Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365, and Oracle NetSuite. Webinar with the Model Hardware Standard research preview is scheduled Nov 17.
install: Available via claude.com/plugins directory (enterprise Cowork plugin)

name: Claude Code v2.1.321
hook: Released Nov 9: Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2) is now the default Fable model, an optional fast mode delivers up to 2.5× faster token generation, and two security patches landed—one fixing MCP OAuth refresh tokens leaking to unintended hosts, another closing a read-only Bash sandbox bypass.

name: Claude Code Game Studios
hook: A Shell-based framework that turns Claude Code into a 49-agent, 72-skill game-dev studio (MIT license): art direction, physics design, multiplayer architecture, testing, and more—all wired together. Hit 18,700+ GitHub stars and gained an estimated 5,700 stars this week alone while trending on GitHub.

name: claude-video (/watch skill)
hook: One /watch command lets Claude download any video URL or local file, sample frames with ffmpeg, pull captions via yt-dlp (falls back to Whisper), and answer questions about what it watched. 13,900 GitHub stars and 8,100 install count across skill directories as of July 2026, with continued adoption.

name: claude-mem
recurring_note: ↑ Day 4 — 7,482 stars gained this week; still topping GitHub weekly trending
hook: Persistent memory layer that works across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, and more. Added an estimated 7,482 GitHub stars this week—the strongest single-week gain of any Claude ecosystem repo currently tracked.

name: alirezarezvani/claude-skills (410-skill pack)
hook: One of the most comprehensive community skill collections: 410 skills and 120+ agent configs spanning engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, and finance—all targeting Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 other coding agents. Sitting at ~19,800 GitHub stars with continuous releases.

name: Claude Code Video Toolkit (digitalsamba)
hook: An MIT-licensed toolkit that lets you produce full short-form videos from Claude Code using open-source models that cost cents: script, AI voiceover, music, video clips, and final render—no proprietary API keys required. Around 2,300 GitHub stars, last major update Aug 2026.

name: trending-claude-skills (auto-leaderboard)
hook: An auto-refreshing leaderboard of trending Claude skills and AI agent repos, updated every 15 minutes. Useful as a live feed of what's gaining momentum in the ecosystem without polling GitHub Trending manually.

name: awesome-ai-plugins (hashgraph-online)
hook: A curated cross-agent plugin list covering Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Gemini, Antigravity, Pi, Grok, and more—maintained by the Hedera Open League project. Useful reference when evaluating which plugins have multi-agent support beyond Claude Code alone.
